info.name: garden-of-eden API (gardyn-home3)
info.description:
REST API of the garden-of-eden firmware on the Gardyn Home 3.0, fork `grrretchen/garden-of-eden` branch `gardyn-home3`, generated against commit b0413fa (2026-10-27).

**Auth:** with GARDEN_API_KEY set, every request except `/`, `/health` and `/static` needs the `X-API-Key` header (collection auth uses `{{apiKey}}`). Requests from the Pi itself skip the check.

**Folders:** `v1` is the API the device serves today. `v2` holds the planned changes (on v1 firmware: 404, except `PATCH /pods/{id}` 405, and "Set schedule (If-Match)", which v1 accepts and applies).

⚠ Requests in Pump and some in Light change real hardware.

item.name: Light
item.description: Grow lights, GPIO18 PWM. Levels are 0–100.

request.description: Read from the pin (true even after cron changes).

originalRequest.description: Read from the pin (true even after cron changes).

request.description: `value` 0–100; 400 if out of range. Saves state.
Full brightness (100) if currently off; no change if already on.
Off now. The next scheduled ramp turns it back on.

item.name: Pump
item.description: ⚠ Runs the real pump. Only with water in the tank. Levels are 0–100.

request.description: Current duty; 0 when stopped.
⚠ Runs the real pump. Only with water in the tank. Starts the pump at `value` % (0 stops it) and arms the MAX_PUMP_RUN_SECONDS safety cut-off.
⚠ Runs the real pump. Only with water in the tank. Runs at DEFAULT_PUMP_SPEED (upstream: 100 %), with the MAX_PUMP_RUN_SECONDS safety cut-off.
Stops the pump.
⚠ Runs the real pump. Only with water in the tank. Runs at DEFAULT_PUMP_SPEED (upstream: 100 %) for `seconds` (1–MAX_PUMP_RUN_SECONDS; default is the cap, 900). Returns at once.
INA219 readings (bus V, mA, mW, shunt mV), read on I2C bus 1. Takes about 1 s.

originalRequest.description: INA219 readings (bus V, mA, mW, shunt mV), read on I2C bus 1. Takes about 1 s.

item.name: Schedule
item.description: Stored as JSON (~/.garden_schedule.json) and compiled into the crontab. HA's sync automation overwrites changes made here (see the proposal).

request.description: Normalized per-day schedule.
Replaces the whole schedule and rewrites the crontab. ⚠ HA will push its own copy back within seconds. Body below is the current schedule.

item.name: Grow cycle
item.description: Grow-cycle reminders are disabled on this device (*_REMINDER_DAYS=0); CropOps owns reminders.

request.description: Stage, start time, due and acknowledged reminders.

originalRequest.description: Stage, start time, due and acknowledged reminders.

request.description: Resets the cycle start to now. The page's Germinate preset calls this.
One of germination, thinning, root_check, harvest.
Key: thinning, root_check, harvest, nutrient.
